heading: JEE Main 2027 session 1 registration: Check steps to apply, list of required documents and key details
author: TOI Education /  Sep 21, 2026, 13:02 IST
paragraphs: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has announced the tentative dates for the Joint Entrance Examination Main (JEE Main) 2027 Session 1
The January session will be held on January 22, 23, 24, 28, 29 and 30, 2027
January 31 has been kept as a buffer date.The JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration date has not been announced yet
Based on the registration schedule followed in the previous cycle, the application process is expected to begin in October 2026

However, candidates should wait for the official NTA notification before treating any specific October date as final.Once the registration window opens, candidates will be able to apply online through the official JEE Main website.The official notification and information bulletin will mention the application start date, last date to apply, fee payment deadline and correction window, among other details.JEE Main 2027 Session 1: How to applyCandidates will be able to complete the JEE Main 2027 application form online after NTA starts the registration process.The steps to apply are expected to be:Visit the official JEE Main website.Click on the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration link.Complete the registration process using the required details.Fill in the personal and academic information in the application form.Upload the required documents, photograph and other details as specified.Select the examination-related preferences.Pay the application fee through the available online payment options.Check all the details entered in the form carefully.Submit the application form.Download and save a copy of the confirmation page for future reference.The exact application process and list of documents will be confirmed in the JEE Main 2027 information bulletin.JEE Main 2027 registration: Documents and details to keep readyCandidates can keep their basic academic and identification details ready before the registration window opens

The final requirements will be mentioned by NTA in the information bulletin.Applicants will need the following:Details/documentsWhat candidates should keep readyAcademic detailsClass 10 and Class 12 recordsIdentification detailsValid identification information as prescribed by NTACategory detailsApplicable category or reservation certificate, if requiredPhotographRecent photograph in the prescribed formatOther application detailsPersonal and academic information required in the formCandidates should also make sure that their identification details and applicable category or reservation certificates are updated before filling out the application form.What candidates should do nowSince the registration date has not been announced, candidates can use this time to keep their academic and identification details ready
They should also check their documents and certificates before the application window opens.Aspirants should follow the official NTA and JEE Main websites for the confirmed application schedule
The official notification will also provide details about the fee, city intimation slip, admit card and result dates.Get the latest Education News and Live updates
